caption: The video showcases a vertical soap film suspended between two fixed white horizontal rods against a black background, its surface divided into stacked horizontal interference bands. A dark foamy zone caps the top, followed by blue, yellow-orange, violet, green, and pink-violet stripes fading into a pale gray-blue region near the lower rod. Throughout, the stack of colored bands drifts slowly downward relative to the stationary rods. As they descend, the pale gray-blue area at the bottom shrinks while the deep blue and green stripes settle noticeably lower. Wispy vertical streaks over the upper blue and yellow region shift shape and intensity, and the dark foamy boundary evolves subtly. The left edge curves inward and the right edge keeps its streaky texture, both persisting while the interior pattern moves. The rods, background, and camera stay fixed, so the motion is confined to the slow movement of the film's pattern.
